items.name: Acid Bass Synth
items.description: Resonant transistor-style acid bass synthesizer with saturated diode ladder filter.

items.name: Space Tape FX
items.description: Dual-peak resonant formant filter with LFO vowel morphing and warm saturation.

items.name: Supersaw Lead Synth
items.description: Multi-oscillator detuned hypersaw lead synthesizer with resonant filter.

items.name: Tape Phaser FX
items.description: 4-stage optical tape phaser with swept allpass notches and feedback saturation.

items.name: FM Bell Synth
items.description: Dual-operator phase modulation FM chime and bell synthesizer with resonant formant damping.

items.name: Shimmer Delay FX
items.description: Multi-tap pitch-diffused shimmer delay with cross-fed harmonic reflections and damping filter.

items.name: Phase Distortion Synth
items.description: Casio CZ-style phase distortion synthesizer with resonant formant windowing and analog saturation.

items.name: Formant Filter FX
items.description: Dual-cavity resonant vocal formant filter with vowel cavity morphing and driven saturator.

items.name: Wavetable Morph Synth
items.description: Multi-profile wavetable oscillator with continuous morphing across warm sine, folded triangle, saw and pulsed harmonics.

items.name: Wavefolder Drive FX
items.description: West Coast multi-stage analog wavefolder with continuous folding thresholds, DC symmetry bias and tone filter.

items.name: Additive Harmonic Synth
items.description: Eight-partial additive harmonic overtone generator with continuous spectral tilt, odd/even balance, shimmer emphasis and analog saturation.

items.name: Comb Resonator FX
items.description: Dual-coupled harmonic tuned resonator with adjustable resonance Q, acoustic decay damping, overdrive saturation and wet/dry mix.

items.name: Hard Sync Synth
items.description: Master/slave oscillator with dynamic formant sync sweep, sub-oscillator and analog diode saturation.

items.name: Ring Modulator FX
items.description: Diode ring modulator with variable carrier frequency, carrier wave shaping, LFO tremolo and wet/dry mix.

items.name: Subharmonic Synth
items.description: Subharmonic division oscillator with dual quantized sub-octave generators (1/2, 1/3, 1/4), pulse-width modulation and warm low-pass saturation.

items.name: Bitcrush Degrader FX
items.description: Sample-rate decimation and variable bit-depth reduction with jitter noise, analog pre-drive and wet/dry mix.

items.name: Karplus-Strong Synth
items.description: Physical modeling plucked string synthesizer using the Karplus-Strong algorithm with noise burst excitation, low-pass loss filter and body resonance.

items.name: Frequency Shifter FX
items.description: Bode-style single-sideband frequency shifter with quadrature Hilbert phase-shifting, through-zero shift modulation and harmonic ring modulation.

items.name: Feedback FM Lead Synth
items.description: Two-operator frequency modulation synthesizer with modulator self-feedback.

items.name: Spectral Additive Organ Synth
items.description: Additive tonewheel organ synthesizer with harmonic drawbars and key-click.

items.name: Stereo Ping-Pong Delay FX
items.description: Stereo cross-feedback ping-pong delay with lowpass tape damping.

items.name: Tube Preamp Overdrive FX
items.description: Asymmetric vacuum tube preamplifier model with dynamic grid-bias sag.

items.name: Inharmonic Chime Synth
items.description: Metallic chime and acoustic bell physical synthesis using 6 Bessel-zero plate modes.

items.name: Analog Supershape Pad Synth
items.description: Polyphonic pad synthesizer with 3 detuned cores, supershape wavefolding, and 4-pole diode filter.

items.name: Multiband Tape Saturator FX
items.description: Three-band crossover tape saturator with low-end magnetic head hysteresis and dynamic tape bias.

items.name: Dimension Spatial Chorus FX
items.description: Multi-stage bucket brigade chorus with out-of-phase dual LFO modulation and spatial diffusion.

items.name: Spectral Drone Synth
items.description: Multi-timbral additive drone synthesizer with 8 Chebyshev partials, microtonal detune drift, and non-linear tape saturation.

items.name: Resonant Brass Synth
items.description: Physical modeling acoustic brass synthesizer with non-linear lip-reed valve oscillation and variable bell acoustic impedance.

items.name: Biquad Morph Filter FX
items.description: Continuous state-variable filter morphing smoothly from lowpass to notch, bandpass, and highpass with saturated resonance.

items.name: Harmonic Tremolo Panner FX
items.description: Dual-band crossover harmonic tremolo with anti-phase high/low modulation and photocoupler optical response.

items.name: Buchla Complex Oscillator Synth
items.description: Dual complex oscillator synthesizer with primary triangle core, audio-rate exponential FM cross-modulation, and multi-stage timbre wavefolding.

items.name: String Resonator Modal Synth
items.description: Bank of 8 coupled inharmonic modal resonators with dispersive stiffness, non-linear hammer strike impulse, and sympathetic acoustic decay.

items.name: Hilbert Frequency Shifter FX
items.description: Single-sideband analytic frequency shifter using a 90-degree Hilbert quadrature network and quadrature carrier oscillator for true linear spectrum translation.

items.name: Granular Pitch Shifter Delay FX
items.description: Multi-head micro-loop granular pitch shifter with Hann envelope grain cross-fading, pitch interval transposition, and diffuse regeneration.

items.name: Cyber Acid 303 Synth
items.description: Saturated diode ladder acid bassline synthesizer with accented envelope decay, nonlinear transistor feedback saturation, and resonant chirp modulation.

items.name: Spectral Resonator Bell Synth
items.description: Physical acoustic model of metallic inharmonic bells and gamelan plates with modal strike impulse, dispersive overtone damping, and shimmering acoustic resonance.

items.name: Analog Tape Warble FX
items.description: Magnetic tape deck emulator with hysteresis saturation, dual-rate wow and flutter motor instability, and head azimuth high-frequency loss.

items.name: Spectral Freeze Reverb FX
items.description: Infinite-tail ambient shimmer reverb with prime feedback delay network, spectral absorption tilt, and infinite freeze hold matrix.

items.name: Liminal Drone Pad Synth
items.description: Hypnagogic dark ambient drone synthesizer with detuned multi-oscillator harmonic cluster, sub-octave fundamental saturation, slow-drift chorus modulation, and four-pole ladder lowpass filter.

items.name: Ditherpunk Chiptune Lead Synth
items.description: Lo-fi 8-bit chiptune synthesizer with variable pulse-width duty cycle modulation, bit-crush quantization decimation, and snappily accented pitch decay.

items.name: Chavetta Tape Saturator FX
items.description: Vintage analog magnetic tape deck saturator with soft-knee asymmetric hysteresis clipping, dual-stage motor flutter warble, and tape head damping.

items.name: Op Art Phaser Matrix FX
items.description: Multistage optical phaser processor with four-pole allpass phase-shift ladder, quadrature sinusoidal sweep modulation, and resonant feedback matrix.

items.name: Acid Bass 303 Lead Synth
items.description: Classic diode-ladder resonant 303 bassline and lead synthesizer with snappy decaying filter envelope, variable accent bite, and asymmetric overdrive saturation.

items.name: Brutalist Sub-Bass Rumble Synth
items.description: Heavy monolithic sub-bass generator with dual sub-octave dividers, warm even harmonic wave folding, and seismic low-frequency pressure envelope.

items.name: Glitch Bitcrush Buffer Stutter FX
items.description: Post-digital audio mangler with variable bit-depth decimation, sample-rate reduction hold, and audio-triggered rhythmic buffer stutter repeats.

items.name: Liquid Chorus Flanger Matrix FX
items.description: Iridescent stereo BBD delay matrix with multi-phase sinusoidal LFO modulation, through-zero flanging sweep, and cross-channel feedback dispersion.

items.name: Analog CRT Phosphor Beam Synth
items.description: Cathode ray vector beam oscillator with morphing sawtooth-pulse waveform, sub-octave divider, 4-pole resonant beam focusing filter, and warm analog cathode saturation.

items.name: Op Art Spectral Chime Synth
items.description: Multi-partial inharmonic additive chime and bell synthesizer with kinetic beating moire modulations, metallic partial ratios, and shimmering exponential modal decays.

items.name: Analog CRT Tape Flutter FX
items.description: Magnetic tape and cathode scanline delay with dual-rate wow/flutter drift modulation, warm asymmetric saturation, and high-frequency tape head damping.

items.name: Op Art Frequency Shifter FX
items.description: Bode-style single-sideband frequency shifter with quadrature phase splitting, endless barber-pole Shepard tone phase sweeps, and cross-channel dispersion.

items.name: Dub Techno Chord Stab Synth
items.description: Minor triad chord stab synthesizer with resonant lowpass filter sweep, noise breath, and exponential envelope decay.

items.name: Dub Techno Sub Rumble Synth
items.description: Sub-octave sinusoidal bass synthesizer with warm soft saturation, pitch glide envelope, and deep low-end punch.

items.name: Drone Kosmische Space Delay FX
items.description: Dual tape space echo with drifting motor wow, damping lowpass filter in feedback loop, and stereo cross-reflections.

items.name: Drone Kosmische Resonator Filter FX
items.description: Four-pole resonant state-variable filter with slow LFO phase modulation, harmonic comb resonance, and soft drive.

items.description: A wave-terrain synth driving a slowly turning mandala.

items.name: Ordered Dither
items.description: A 4x4 Bayer dither: any picture becomes two inks on paper. The series look from the films.

items.name: Liquid Glass
items.description: A frosted, refracting glass pane over whatever is behind it: bent edges, a colour split and a lit rim.

items.name: Metaball Lens
items.description: Three liquid lobes drift over the picture, merging into one blob that refracts and magnifies what is under it.

items.name: Pixel Plate
items.description: A plate of square cells with ragged, notched edges that grows outward cell by cell.

items.name: Iridescent Orb
items.description: A soft holographic pastel ball that slowly spins its colours, with a white sheen and a gloss spot.

items.name: Phyllotaxis Bloom
items.description: A sunflower of golden-angle seeds, each dot coloured along the spiral. Seed count and turn are live.

items.name: Lorenz Attractor
items.description: The butterfly of chaos, integrated live. A glowing trail winds between two lobes and never repeats.

items.name: Lotka-Volterra
items.description: Predators and prey chasing each other: the population curves on top, the phase loop they trace below.

items.name: Scale-Free Network
items.description: A network that grows by preferential attachment: the rich get richer, hubs emerge, and the graph breathes.

items.name: Rule 110
items.description: A one-dimensional cellular automaton that is Turing-complete. Gliders scroll down the page, one generation at a time.

items.name: Clifford Attractor
items.description: A strange attractor drawn as a cloud of 20,000 points. Slowly drifting parameters keep reshaping the lace.

items.name: Chladni Cymatics
items.description: Resonant 2D standing wave nodal lines on a circular plate. Sound shifts the modal geometry between harmonics.

items.name: Rössler Attractor
items.description: Continuous-time chaotic attractor with a spiraling planar disc and vertical folding plume.

items.name: Torus Knot 3D
items.description: Parametric braided (p, q) torus knot with tubular geometry and orbiting satellite spheres.

items.name: Acid Bass Synth
items.description: Resonant transistor-style acid bass synthesizer with saturated diode ladder filter and sub-octave drive.

items.name: Space Tape FX
items.description: Dual-peak resonant formant filter with LFO vowel morphing and warm saturation.

items.name: Quantum Vortex
items.description: Relativistic swirling energy vortex with audio-reactive event horizon warping and chromatic accretion glow.

items.name: De Jong Attractor
items.description: Peter de Jong chaotic map accumulating glowing density filaments from four sinusoidal phase terms.

items.name: Möbius Strip 3D
items.description: Parametric non-orientable Möbius ribbon with transverse tubular rungs, edge rails and orbiting satellites.

items.name: Supersaw Lead Synth
items.description: Multi-oscillator detuned hypersaw lead synthesizer with sub-octave support, resonant filter and snappy ADSR envelope.

items.name: Tape Phaser FX
items.description: 4-stage optical tape phaser with swept allpass notches, feedback resonance and warm diode saturation.

items.name: Pulsar Beam
items.description: Rotating magnetized neutron star with relativistic synchrotron light cones, dipole magnetic flux arcs and audio-reactive horizon flare.

items.name: Hopalong Attractor
items.description: Barry Martin's Hopalong chaotic map generating glowing fractal filaments and cosmic web filaments.

items.name: Klein Bottle 3D
items.description: Parametric 4D topological Klein bottle immersed in 3D with transverse wireframe ribs, spine rails and orbiting energy quanta.

items.name: FM Bell Synth
items.description: Dual-operator phase modulation FM chime and bell synthesizer with exponential index envelope and resonant formant damping.

items.name: Shimmer Delay FX
items.description: Multi-tap pitch-diffused shimmer delay with cross-fed harmonic reflections, tape saturation and damping filter.

items.name: Neural Synapse
items.description: Bio-electric neural dendritic lattice with audio-reactive action potential pulses, synaptic neurotransmitter flares and synaptic vesicle nodes.

items.name: Gumowski-Mira
